role: RESEARCH ONLY - ground-level / close-up RGB PV visual defect detector
does_not_replace: weights/yolo_solar.pt (aerial/overhead panel detector) - different domain, classes, and training data
source_checkpoint: best.pt from Kaggle kernel edithstark/ground-yolo11n-baseline-v1 (version 2), epoch 88

excluded_classes.bird_drop: only 9 images / ~3 unique source photos in the audited source dataset - insufficient independent data to train or evaluate. Data-availability exclusion for this experiment, NOT a product limitation.
excluded_classes.hotspot: out of scope - RGB imagery cannot validate thermal-hotspot semantics

dataset: panel solar (Susan) / Roboflow Universe, version 1 - audited + remediated leakage-clean 3-class derived set
dataset_license: CC BY 4.0 (as displayed by Roboflow); image-level provenance not independently verified

evaluation.protocol: Ultralytics YOLO.val(), imgsz=640, iou=0.50, on the leakage-clean split

overfitting: mild - train losses fell throughout while val metrics plateaued after ~epoch 60 (best epoch 88); val losses did not degrade (val/dfl rose slightly 1.078 @ep51 -> 1.109 @ep100). Held-out test metrics >= validation metrics, so no leakage-driven inflation.

cross_domain_check.note: confirms the ground model does NOT replace the aerial detector

on_120_ground_closeup_test_images.ground_research_model_conf0.25: panel detected in 94/120 images (78%), 104 panel boxes

cross_domain_check.aerial_protocol_reverse_direction: PENDING - ground model on the aerial test split (E:/Solar AI Training Images/yolo_prepared/test) needs the E: drive remounted

limitations: bird_drop not trained or evaluated (data availability) - no bird_drop performance claim
no RGB hotspot detection - out of scope
dusty test set has only ~69 instances across few families -> its test metrics are high-variance
source image-level provenance unverified; ~574 unique source photos behind 6,492 augmented instances
domain gap: source images may differ from the owner's rooftop photos; real-world holdout inference pending E: remount
research artifact - not wired into models/ or services/ production inference; branch not merged
